C1_clause_interaction.verdict: flooring 4 of 24 cells (17%) satisfies C1's MEAN clause, but C1 also requires dF < 0 in >= 75% of cells. An arm that reaches the floor on a minority of cells and leaves the rest unchanged therefore FAILS C1. The fraction clause is what stops the absence encoding buying a pass on a few cells; the two clauses are not redundant and both are load-bearing.
